name: Outlook / Microsoft 365
summary: @(Outlook.com, Hotmail and work or school accounts on Microsoft 365.)

steps.text: @(Enter your email address, then choose Sign in with Microsoft.)
@(Approve the access Microsoft asks for. Your password never reaches TotalMail.)
@(Work and school accounts may need approval from the organization administrator.)

setup.text: @(Register an application in Microsoft Entra, for accounts in any organization and personal accounts.)
@(Add the web redirect address shown in the administrator guide, then create a client secret.)
@(Put the application ID and the secret in the administrator window (Account types and sign-in), then try again.)

note: @(Sign-in with Microsoft is not set up on this server. Ask the administrator to add the application ID.)
redirectNote: @(Return address to register in Microsoft Entra, under the Web platform.)
